# COSHUMA

> Independent AI and SaaS buyer guides focused on pricing, trials, comparisons, buyer fit, and practical buying decisions.

Product prices, trial terms, discounts, and outbound destinations can change; use the linked vendor source on each guide to verify final terms before purchase.

High-intent guides below prioritize concrete buying questions such as free trials, pricing, discounts, alternatives, comparisons, and plan fit.
